features.title: Plan card for todo_write
features.summary: Each todo_write call is drawn as a plan card: "Step 2 of 3 · Fix the rounding bug", expanding to every step with a done, active or pending glyph and how long it took. Timing comes from the times of successive todo_write calls, followed back across turns while the plan keeps a step. A call the card cannot read, or that failed, shows the native todo row.
reach: fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "[[call todo_write {\"todos\":[{\"content\":\"Read the pricing module\",\"status\":\"in_progress\"},{\"content\":\"Fix the rounding bug\",\"status\":\"pending\"},{\"content\":\"Run the cart tests\",\"status\":\"pending\"}]}]]"

fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "[[call todo_write {\"todos\":[{\"content\":\"Read the pricing module\",\"status\":\"completed\"},{\"content\":\"Fix the rounding bug\",\"status\":\"in_progress\"},{\"content\":\"Run the cart tests\",\"status\":\"pending\"}]}]]"
expect button "Step 2 of 3: Fix the rounding bug. Show the plan"
click button "Step 2 of 3: Fix the rounding bug. Show the plan"

configuration.constraints: Boolean; master switch for every agent-plan card. Off restores every native view.
Boolean; draw todo_write calls as the plan card instead of the native todo row.
Boolean; show how long each step took, from successive todo_write call times.

failureModes: A plan whose earlier todo_write calls fell outside the loaded history times its steps only from the writes still loaded.
A step the agent marked done without first marking it in progress is timed from the write before it.

onboarding.firstAction: Ask the agent for a multi-step task and let it write a plan.
onboarding.doneWhen: A plan card shows Step N of M and the current step sits beside the composer.

verification.testName: times each step from the writes that started and finished it and points at the active step
reads only valid todo_write arguments and follows a plan back across turns until an unrelated or restarted one

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the plan card renders browser state from Session events and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Current plan step pinned beside the composer
features.summary: While the latest turn's plan has steps left, a chip beside the native plan-mode control says "Step 2 of 3 · Fix the rounding bug · 12s" and opens the whole plan. It sits beside the native control rather than replacing it.
reach: fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "[[call todo_write {\"todos\":[{\"content\":\"Read the pricing module\",\"status\":\"completed\"},{\"content\":\"Fix the rounding bug\",\"status\":\"in_progress\"},{\"content\":\"Run the cart tests\",\"status\":\"pending\"}]}]]"
expect button "Step 2 of 3: Fix the rounding bug. Show the plan"
features.currentSurface: composer: plan chip beside plan mode

configuration.constraints: Boolean; pin the current plan step beside the composer.

failureModes: A plan from an earlier turn is not pinned once a new turn starts, matching the native todo dock.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the pinned step renders browser state from Session events and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Live activity strip beside the composer controls
features.summary: While anything runs, a strip beside the native composer activity says what: the running tool call, background jobs and subagents, with a live timer; it opens the full list with a timer per row. It reads Session events only (tool/call, tool/result, job/registered, job/settled) and renders nothing while idle.
reach: fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "[[call bash {\"command\":\"sleep 20\",\"description\":\"Wait twenty seconds\"}]]"

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show the live activity strip beside the composer controls.

failureModes: Background jobs registered before the loaded history window are not listed until their next event.
Queued messages are not counted here: the native queue dock above the composer already lists them.

verification.testName: keeps calls without a result, background jobs and subagents apart until they settle

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the live activity strip renders browser state from Session events and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Retry and Ask to fix under failed turns
features.summary: Under a native turn-error row, and under a model-retry row once retrying gave up, a bar shows the retry count and two actions: Retry puts a retry request in the composer, Ask to fix inserts the failure with a request to fix it. Neither sends: the user reviews and sends. Stopped or interrupted turns get no actions.
reach: fill textbox "Message or run a task, / commands, @ files or sessions" "[[fail The fake provider rejected this request]]"

configuration.constraints: Boolean; add the retry count and Retry / Ask to fix actions under failure rows.

failureModes: Without a Composer provider (@dshfiles/rich-composer) the actions are hidden and only the retry count shows.
Retry does not resend the failed request: it writes a message the user sends, so the next turn starts fresh.

verification.testName: reads a turn error, offers actions unless the turn was stopped, and quotes it in the fix prompt

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the failure card renders browser state from Session events and starts no Host work of its own.

features.title: Tokens left before automatic compaction
features.summary: In the composer's meter line, after the native context ring and before the cost estimate, a chip says how many tokens remain before automatic compaction ("compacts in ~40K", then "compacts next step"); its tooltip gives the trigger and window. The trigger comes from the running context-compaction engine through its threshold API; the live prompt size is the native contextPressure projection the ring reads.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; show tokens left before automatic compaction beside the context meter.

failureModes: Without @dshfiles/context-compaction (stock compaction-basic) the threshold API has no owner and the chip stays hidden.
The count is approximate: the ring's projected size and the engine's own measure can differ by the response tokens.

verification.testName: counts down from the trigger with the size the context ring shows

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the chip renders a projection and one context-compaction API read, whose Host work is traced there.
